tests.detail: 3403 unique chronological rows; each is a sorted five-number subset of 1..40.
Git blob SHA-1 of archive and active scorer match the preregistered blobs and active report.
Each target is scored from archive prefix [0,t); no target or future row is passed to the scorer.
All 3203 forecasts rank every integer 1..40 exactly once.
Top5/Top10/Top20 means reproduce the active engine report in all three chronological splits within 1.1e-6.
Mutating target and later draws leaves pre-target score vectors unchanged at nine fixed cutoffs.
Repeated fixed-prefix score vectors are identical at nine fixed cutoffs.
Dynamic programming enumerates exactly 658008 five-subsets; expected mean rank is exactly 20.5.
Repeated 1000-replicate conditional-null runs with the fixed seed produce identical extreme counts and p-values.
1921 Discovery + 641 Validation + 641 historical Blind OOS = 3203 targets.
